title: Reasoning Models Outperform Standard Language Models in De Novo Protein Design

contributions.purpose: 首次系统比较推理增强 LLM 与标准 LLM 在从头蛋白设计上的能力差异
contributions.mechanism: 五个 ChatGPT 变体用同一自然语言 prompt 直接生成四螺旋束序列,AlphaFold pLDDT>0.75 作成功阈值
contributions.evaluation: 推理模型 o3/o4-mini 成功率 44%/20%,标准模型 GPT-4o/GPT-4.5 均 0% confident 成功
contributions.domain: 从头蛋白设计 / LLM 推理能力
contributions.source_quote: reasoning models (o3, o4-mini) achieved 44% and 20% success rates respectively, while all standard language models achieved 0% success using pLDDT > 75 as the threshold.

contributions.purpose: 用湿实验验证 AI 设计序列可真实折叠
contributions.mechanism: 对两条高分序列做大肠杆菌表达、纯化与圆二色(CD)光谱表征
contributions.evaluation: Helix02(o4-mini,pLDDT 0.887)成功表达,SDS-PAGE >95% 纯度、CD 显示 100% 螺旋含量、208/222nm 双极小值,证实 α-螺旋结构
contributions.source_quote: Two of the top-scoring sequences were experimentally tested. One was validated via circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy, confirming alpha-helical structure.

contributions.purpose: 指出仅有推理能力不足、pLDDT 高不等于可用
contributions.mechanism: 对比推理模型内部差异与失败案例 Helix01
contributions.evaluation: o4-mini-high 高推理努力却 0% confident 成功;Helix01 pLDDT 0.876 却跨 7 株 E. coli 无法表达(重复序列致 RNA 二级结构问题)
contributions.source_quote: even among reasoning models, performance varied dramatically-o4-mini-high, despite using high reasoning effort, achieved 0% confident designs, suggesting that reasoning capability alone is insufficient without proper optimization.

notes: 含负结果/trade-off:标准模型 0% confident,Helix01 计算高分(pLDDT 0.876)却结构失败且实验完全无法表达。作者自曝论文写作由 AI(Claude)主导,并在 checklist 里承认 AI '倾向夸大统计显著性'、需人工验证所有科学解释。整体成功率仅 0-44%,样本极小(N 序列 4-16)。四元组适配良好,三条均 finding 类;C1 亦含 method 成分但核心是对比结论。
